resolution_notes: base_url KEEP original: stable official v3 examples use the host plus /v3, while v3alpha is experimental (https://github.com/google/deps.dev). rate_limits KEEP original: current docs publish no quota, and the official rate-limit issue remains open and unanswered (https://github.com/google/deps.dev/issues/33). cors SET yes: live response reports Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (https://api.deps.dev/v3/systems/npm/packages/react). example SET v3 curl: official GetPackage path and response schema (https://docs.deps.dev/api/v3/).
